episodes.synopsis: Sweet and simple Yasuna and her classmate/international assassin Sonya have a tough challenge when a dog wanders into their classroom.
episodes.title: Sneaking Dog, Blossoming Cherry

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna attempts to learn the sacred art of nunchuks just as she and Sonya encounter an escaped beast. Later, a young girl convinces the pair to play with her.
episodes.title: Nunchaku Skills Bear Balloons

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna tries her hand at mystic voodoo and psychic powers. A red haired girl looks to get revenge on poor Yasuna and Sonya for rejecting her from the main cast.
episodes.title: Cursed Psychic Rain Wrestling

episodes.synopsis: Hot Summer days call for ice cream, beaches and watermelon treats. The fun in the sun stops when an unknown assassin targets Sonya.
episodes.title: Ice Cream Scream Watermelon

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna tries to get Sonya into bug catching. Later the pair head to an outdoor festival, and a trip to the beach finds them stranded with no help in sight.
episodes.title: Buggy Festival Sea Dolls

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna gets a sudden craving for shaved ice and enlists Agiri to help find some. Afterwards, Yasuna and Sonya visit Agiri in her house full of hidden traps.
episodes.title: Navel Mechanism Paper Doll Ice

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna tries to come up with a great idea for the culture festival, but Sonya is once again of no use, except when it comes to besting Yasuna at juggling.
episodes.title: Culture Beanbag Jousting Duel

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna finds herself stuck in a strange place while trying to prank Sonya. Later, the pair mess around with instruments and engage in a game of darts.
episodes.title: Sticking, Strumming, Stabbing

episodes.synopsis: Both Yasuna and Sonya have misplaced their things, and set out to search for them. They later find an enemy assassin instead.
episodes.title: Fishing, Tsuchinokos and Forgotten Things

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna catches a cold after frolicking in the snow, much to Sonya’s annoyance. The girls later have a confusing Christmas party.
episodes.title: Santa Icicle Snow Mantra

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna tries her hardest to get Sonya into making mochi with her. The pair then find themselves in a public bath together.
episodes.title: Bath Kite Rice Cake New Year’s First Dream

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna believes that if she wraps herself in bandages, future injuries wont affect her. Sonya tries to catch up on rest, but Yasuna won’t let her.
episodes.title: Drowsy Chocolate Injury Compress

episodes.synopsis: Yasuna and Agiri hold a birthday party for Sonya without knowing her actual birthday. Later Yasuna admits to Sonya something that she worries about constantly.
episodes.title: Make the Kill Me and Make Me Your Baby
